evidence_scope.production_value_semantics: post_resolver resolved_fields; not raw provider observations
evidence_scope.consumer_semantics: unique runtime source files with a syntactic field reference; definitions, tests, scripts, docs and data excluded

multi_card.reason: visible count of separate physical cards

card_count.reason: visible count of separate physical cards

product.reason: product-line identity may be emblematic or externally constrained

set.reason: literal printed set or insert text

language.reason: language visible on the current card

team.reason: world fact, not a required printed card fact

official_card_type.reason: only literal official wording is accepted

observable_components.reason: visible auto patch relic and related components

parallel_exact.reason: proper parallel identity requires vocabulary or trusted support

parallel.reason: legacy alias reconstructed from canonical finish fields

variation.reason: literal slab or card variation wording/layout

numerical_rarity.reason: CSM projection reconstructed from canonical print-run fields

attributes.reason: aggregate reconstructed from observed boolean components

auto.reason: visible ink sticker or autograph wording
